operations.name: Conrad Kornmann

expected.charges: Opposing the Liberty Loan in a letter to a friend.
expected.sentence: Concurrent five- and ten-year prison terms and a $1,000 fine. Released on bond the day of sentencing; the conviction was reversed and the judgment discharged on February 3, 1919.

updates.indicted: Indicted April 3, 1918 on four counts under the Espionage Act, concerning his July 1, 1917 letter; District of South Dakota, Southern Division, indictment 1730.

operations.source: La Vern J. Rippley, South Dakota History27(3), Fall1997, p.117 and note18 citing original April3,1918 indictment1730 at National Archives. https://paperzz.com/doc/9130651/conrad-kornmann--german---south-dakota-historical-society...
